question: Which Army Act sections did Act 19/1955 (Commanders-in-Chief (Change in Designation) Act) amend?
context_and_evidence: army_act_amendment_chain.csv AA-01 records 'Commander-in-Chief' -> 'Chief of the Army Staff' 'in many sections' without listing them. The regression check (tools/check_completeness_cycle3.py) therefore registers Act 19/1955 against s.3 only and cannot detect its omission from any other section's completeness row (known false-pass limitation). Compilation footnotes give text-layer leads only (e.g. ss.20, 26, 80, 82-85 seen on images pp.27-28); the Act's Schedule is not held (ACQ-01 B6 / PR #8 Gazette in.gazette.e.1955.613). Sections are NOT guessed.
who_can_answer: WS-A after the Act 19/1955 Gazette (Schedule) is examined; or itemisation of all compilation footnote images
